summary: You wrote clear scenario-grounded answers with strong Q2 and Q4. To reach Excellent, tighten measurability in Q1, correct Q3c recombination, fix CAP reasoning in Q5, add a negative consequence in Q6, and meet word limits.
next_steps: Make your Q1 availability response measurable with a % and time bound, e.g. uptime % per month.
Recalculate Q3c end-to-end as series of all components including redundant payment, then derive downtime.
Correct CAP to choose C or A under partition, add one negative ADR consequence, and trim Q2 under 150 words.

criteria.C1: Well done in Q1: you chose relevant attributes and gave a full six-part performance scenario with measurable p95. For Excellent, rewrite your availability response 'stay up most of the time' as measurable, e.g. % uptime per month.
criteria.C2: Excellent in Q2: you clearly recommended modular monolith with scenario-specific team-size and single-VM trade-offs and acknowledged downtime risk that a bug 'can still crash the whole process'. Keep this specificity.
criteria.C3: Well done in Q3: your (a) 99.30% series and (b) 5.0h downtime with working were correct. For Excellent, fix (c): you reported 99.9975% for payment alone, multiply it by other components for end-to-end ~99.80%.
criteria.C4: Excellent in Q4: you correctly explained Circuit Breaker Closed/Open/Half-Open, applied it to the 25-min outage, and gave tuning of '50% of calls in 10 seconds'. Keep linking mechanism to scenario.
criteria.C5: Good in Q5: reasonable choices with concrete Redis TTL and idempotency key. For Excellent, fix CAP: you wrote 'give up partition tolerance' but you must retain P and choose C or A during partition.
criteria.C6: Good in Q6: specific Context and Decision on OrderPaid RabbitMQ and positive smoothing of 'lunch peak'. For Excellent, add at least one negative consequence such as ops complexity or delay.
criteria.C7: Clear writing with headings and IEEE references. For Excellent, bring every answer within 150 words: Q2 at ~180 words starting 'I recommend against a full microservices rewrite' exceeds the limit.
